objective_for_doctor: Assess and manage a young adult patient presenting with altered mental status, suspected of having a serious drug reaction.

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
Doctor: Hello—what brings you in today? Patient: I’m not answering questions. Doctor: Are you feeling feverish or having trouble staying awake? Patient: …
Are you having trouble breathing right now, or any chest pain?
Are you able to speak in full sentences right now?

Doctor: Are you able to speak in full sentences right now? Patient: No—I'm not responding and I feel very drowsy. Doctor: Do you have a fever or feel unusually hot? Patient: …My temperature feels extremely high, and my muscles are stiff.
[DDX] Neuroleptic malignant syndrome, sepsis/meningitis, serotonin syndrome, heat stroke, toxic-metabolic encephalopathy
